newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LAL DISCUSSING YAK SALES WITH PAKISTANIS.
newsitem.headline: LAL DISCUSSING YAK SALES WITH PAKISTANIS.

text.p: Lithuanian Airlines (LAL) is discussing a possible sale of 11 YAK 42 airplanes to Pakistani Airlines, a deal that would rid the national carrier of all of its Russian-made aircraft, the company said on Tuesday.
"Today is only the second day that we have been speaking with them about this contract," LAL General Director Stasys Jarmalavichius told Reuters.

"Now we are only going to sign the letter of intent and then the negotiations will start," Jarmalavichius said, adding that the Pakistanis need to check the quality of the aircraft and the number of flying hours logged by each.
Jarmalavichius said that besides the 11 YAKs, the LAL fleet consists of three Boeing 737s, one Saab 340 and one Jetstar 731. LAL expects to add another Saab at the end of the month.
